modifiers: small closed padlock in the bottom-right corner
depiction.composition: single central object with a bottom-right corner badge

readings.meaning: privacy, private viewing, or visibility restrictions

ambiguity: May be confused with a generic security or password icon, or an eye-slash (hidden) icon at very small sizes.

reasoning: The icon combines an eye (viewing/visibility) with a padlock (security/restriction), clearly communicating privacy settings, visibility controls, or read-only permissions. It fits a focused set of digital privacy and access-control tasks well, though at tiny sizes the padlock badge must be distinguished from a plain eye icon used for optometry or watching.
